text: Correction: my earlier note implied this was clean, but d9cc3eb failed agent-watcher CI. The OpenCode test fixture used a rollback journal with no busy timeout, so under modernc.org/sqlite a reader made the writer fail with SQLITE_BUSY. Production was unaffected, because real OpenCode databases use WAL, confirmed on 1.19.5. The fixture now matches them, and CI is green at e585504.
